source_text: Iam itaque vobis ipsi reddite rationem, ne putetis indignum, ut qui non admittuntur in regnum Dei, sint sub illo qui cecidit de regno Dei
pass_a_gloss: Already and-so to-you themselves reddite reason, lest putetis indignum, so-that/as who not admittuntur in kingdom of-God, may-be under illo who cecidit about/from in-the-kingdom of-God.

lemmas.lexica: LS ratio; Blaise use of reason required for sin

pass_b_english: Augustine reports that Julian and his party do not admit those who have been born into God’s kingdom unless they are washed in baptism.

choices.why: For Julian, sin requires rational choice; infants lack usus rationis.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Contra Iulianum / Against Julian), including authorities Julian quoted; Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded. This row is Augustine's report; Pass A glosses only the Julian words recoverable here.
